title.tr: Platformlu ahşap merdiven ve çaprazlı korkuluk
title.en: Timber stairs with a platform and cross-braced railing

alt.tr: Yandan görünen platformlu ahşap merdiven; çaprazlı korkuluk, yanda yeşil telli çit ve ev cephesi
alt.en: Side view of timber stairs with a platform, a cross-braced railing, green wire fencing and the house facade beside

caption.tr: Merdivenin ortasında geniş bir platform var. Korkuluk platformu çevreleyip basamaklara devam ediyor.
caption.en: A wide platform sits in the middle of the stairs. The railing wraps around the platform and carries on along the steps.
